scenarios.name: go_src_edit
scenarios.expectation: //go/greet and everything that links it (greeter, its images, greet_test).

scenarios.name: go_src_comment
scenarios.expectation: Compiled outputs are identical, so ideally nothing; content-hashing tools flag the go/greet closure.

scenarios.name: py_src_edit
scenarios.expectation: //py/lib, its test and //py/app (sources ship in runfiles).

scenarios.name: data_file_edit
scenarios.description: Edit data/a.json, consumed through a glob() filegroup.
scenarios.expectation: Everything built from //data:json or //data:a.json: the bundles, :shout, :summary and :check_test.

scenarios.name: new_globbed_file
scenarios.description: Add data/c.json, picked up by glob(["*.json"]).
scenarios.expectation: Consumers of //data:json; not //tools:shout (depends on a.json only).
scenarios.diffstat:
data/c.json | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
 create mode 100644 data/c.json

scenarios.name: docs_edit
scenarios.description: Edit docs/README.md, which no target references.

scenarios.name: chmod_source
scenarios.description: Add the exec bit to go/greet/greet.go.
scenarios.expectation: Nothing affected (compiled outputs don't depend on source modes).

scenarios.name: rename_source
scenarios.description: Rename go/greet/greet.go to greeting.go and update srcs.
scenarios.expectation: Ideally nothing beyond what embeds file names; tools typically flag the go/greet closure.
scenarios.diffstat:
go/greet/BUILD.bazel               | 2 +-
 go/greet/{greet.go => greeting.go} | 0
 2 files changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)
 rename go/greet/{greet.go => greeting.go} (100%)
